rows.statement: Share of NFL head coach firings that happen during the regular season rather than after it: 16 of 44 over the 2020 to 2025 seasons (36 percent).

sources.citation: Sports Illustrated, NFL Head Coach Firings By Year (published and modified 2026-01-06, https://www.si.com/nfl/nfl-head-coach-firings-by-year)
sources.quote: The amount of total head coach firings range from five to nine over the past nine seasons.

sources.citation: NBC New York, History of Black Monday NFL coaches fired (2026-01-05, updated 2026-01-19, https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/sports/nfl/history-black-monday-nfl-coaches-fired/)
sources.quote: Three teams fired their coaches during the 2024 regular season

rows.notes: DERIVED by listing coaches: in-season firings named by NBC (2020: Patricia, Quinn, O'Brien; 2021: Meyer, Gruden; 2022: Rhule, Reich, Hackett; 2023: McDaniels, Reich, Staley; 2024: Saleh, Allen, Eberflus; 2025: Callahan, Daboll) over SI season totals; 2025 is partial (as of 2026-01-06). 2017 to 2019 cannot be split from the pages read. rows.statement: NFL head coaches fired in the middle of an active season since 2000: 34 (about 1.3 a season over 26 seasons); 88 since the 1970 merger.

sources.citation: Sportskeeda, How many NFL coaches fired mid season (undated, https://www.sportskeeda.com/nfl/how-many-nfl-coaches-fired-mid-season)

rows.notes: ONE SOURCE, undated page. Cross-check only: 34 in 26 seasons is about 1.3 a season, against 2.7 a season (16 in 6) in 2020 to 2025, so the recent rate is double the long-run rate. No per-year breakdown for 2000 to 2016 was readable. Web quotes as returned by the cloud web fetch on 2026-11-26 (page text not saved locally, so the quote lint cannot re-find them).

rows.statement: FBS head coaches fired between Week 1 and November 1: 10 across the 2010 to 2013 seasons (2.5 a season); 10 in 2025 by October 28.

sources.citation: OutKick, College Football Teams Are Firing Coaches More Quickly Than Ever (2025-10-28, citing The Athletic, https://www.outkick.com/sports/college-football-coaching-carousel-reaches-new-unprecedented-level-10-early-season-firings)
sources.quote: From 2010 through 2013, there were 10 head coaches fired between Week 1 and November 1 of each individual season.

rows.notes: ONE SOURCE (citing The Athletic); the sentence is ambiguous between 10 in total and 10 each season, read as 10 in total because the same page says 2025 is already a record at 10. The FBS in-season SHARE of all firings could not be computed: no page read gives in-season and total firings for the same year. Partial figures: 31 FBS jobs opened in the 2023-24 cycle, 12 by termination (39 percent of openings, Yahoo/Deseret, 2024-02-17); Power 5 midseason changes 36 in the playoff era (ESPN 2022-11-01); six Power Four in-season firings by 2025-10-22 (Fox/AP). No FBS share is claimed. Web quotes as returned by the cloud web fetch on 2026-11-26 (page text not saved locally, so the quote lint cannot re-find them).
